snippet.title: The King of Fighters AFK - Android Gameplay
snippet.description:
The legendary fighting game The King of Fighters returns! Play now and battle to become the best fighter in the world!

The fight is now on a bigger scale! Emerge victorious in exciting 5 vs. 5 team battles. Bigger moments and even bigger fights await!

YOU are the host of THE KING OF FIGHTERS AFK! But danger lurks around every corner as villains threaten to ruin the tournament! Defeat them in your journey to become the greatest tournament host in the world!

The King of Fighters © SNK
Developed and published by Netmarble
Also released on iOS
